name: swe2-dispatch-marketplace
description: Dispatch bounded tasks to an external SWE-2 agent from a Claude Code session, confined to a task-owned git worktree.

plugins.name: swe2-dispatch
plugins.description: Hand a bounded implementation task to an external SWE-2 agent (Cognition's devin CLI) running inside a task-owned git worktree under a seatbelt profile, and collect a compact, verifiable result. The worker cannot stage, commit, or write outside the worktree.
